map.输入风量、系统阻力、风机效率等参数，计算风机轴功率、电机功率并推荐标准电机功率等: Enter airflow, system resistance, fan efficiency, etc.; compute fan shaft power, motor power, and recommend a standard motor-power rating.
map.按系统所需风量和工作全压初选风机，再算轴功率配电机。: Pre-select a fan by required airflow and working total pressure, then compute shaft power to size the motor.
map.对比同风量下不同全压方案的功率与噪声。: Compare power and noise of different total-pressure schemes at the same airflow.
map.变频改造按运行风量点重算实际功率节能。: VFD retrofit recomputes actual power at the operating airflow point for energy saving.
map.风量 10000 m³/h、全压 800 Pa、效率 75%: Airflow 10000 m^3/h, total pressure 800 Pa, efficiency 75%
map.：轴功率 N = 10000×800 ÷ (3600×1000×0.75) ≈: : shaft power N = 10000 x 800 / (3600 x 1000 x 0.75) approx 2.96 kW, pick a 3-4 kW motor for margin.
map.：效率从 0.75 降到 0.60，同工况功率升到 3.70 kW，低效长期运行: : efficiency from 0.75 down to 0.60, same duty power rises to 3.70 kW; long low-efficiency runs cost much electricity.
map.全压和静压区别？: Difference between total and static pressure?
map.全压=静压+动压，选型用系统阻力对应的全压；只看静压会低估所需功率。: Total pressure = static + dynamic; select by total pressure matching system resistance; static only underestimates required power.
map.电机功率留多少裕量？: How much motor-power margin to leave?
map.一般取计算轴功率的 1.1~1.2 倍，并核对启动特性与变频范围。: Generally take 1.1-1.2 times the calculated shaft power, and check starting characteristics and VFD range.
